def main():
    total_rounds = int(input())
    alice_moves = list(map(int, input().split()))
    bob_moves = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    bob_moves = bob_moves[1:] + [bob_moves[0]]
    min_wins, max_wins = 0, 0
    
    for i in range(total_rounds):
        min_wins += min(alice_moves[i], bob_moves[i])
        
    max_bob_choice = max(bob_moves)
    for i in range(total_rounds):
        if bob_moves[i] == max_bob_choice and bob_moves[i] + alice_moves[i] > min_wins:
            min_wins = bob_moves[i] + alice_moves[i]
    max_alice_choice = max(alice_moves)
    for i in range(total_rounds):
        if alice_moves[i] == max_alice_choice and alice_moves[i] + bob_moves[i] > min_wins:
            min_wins = alice_moves[i] + bob_moves[i]
    min_wins = min_wins - total_rounds if min_wins > total_rounds else 0
    print(f'{min_wins} {max_wins}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
